question: If root-to-leaf paths from the same observed MLE-agent forest are treated as independent records and uniformly split 80/10/10, how much exact canonical-edge support is expected to cross from train into validation/test, and is that risk broad across tasks and physical runs?

design_timing.interpretation: The global values are transparent post-hoc deterministic corollaries of an already released multiplicity histogram. Only the anonymous task/run breadth and anti-dominance profile is a result-after-freeze readout.

fixed_population.population_rule: Reuse every observed fragment, canonical child-parent edge, and root-to-leaf path from the fixed outcome-blind tree-native/path-compatible certificate; no task, run, fragment, path, edge, or multiplicity subset may be selected after breadth values are computed.

split_design.partition_law: Uniform over all fixed-size assignments of the 3599 path records to disjoint train/validation/test sets.

estimands.edge_multiplicity: m_e is the number of distinct root-to-leaf path records containing canonical edge e.
estimands.fixed_set_allocation_probability: For a fixed subset S of s paths, P(all m selected paths lie in S)=C(s,m)/C(N,m), interpreted as zero when m>s.
estimands.canonical_overlap_fraction: sum_e P_e(T,X) divided by the number of canonical observed edges.
estimands.unique_test_edge_contamination_ratio_of_: sum_e P_e(T,X) divided by sum_e P(edge e appears in test). This is a ratio of expectations, not the expectation of a random ratio.
estimands.test_occurrence_contamination_ratio_of_e: The expected number of test path-edge rows whose same canonical edge has at least one train occurrence, divided by the expected number of test path-edge rows. For edge e this uses P(any of its other m_e-1 paths is train | one designated occurrence is test).
estimands.group_profile: Recompute the test-occurrence contamination ratio of expectations within each task, physical run, and observed fragment while retaining the same global fixed-size partition law; emit only sorted anonymous aggregates.
estimands.contribution_share: A group's expected contaminated test-occurrence numerator divided by the global numerator.

fixed_distribution_summary.histogram_rule: Left-closed/right-open bins, except the final bin includes 1. Emit anonymous counts and nearest-rank median/p90/maximum only.
fixed_distribution_summary.conditionable_group: A group with positive expected test path-edge mass; groups with zero contamination remain in the breadth denominator.

classification_rule: Any hard-gate failure maps to GATE_FAIL. Otherwise an axis is broad only when its breadth and anti-dominance gates pass. Both axes broad maps to BROAD; exactly one maps to the matching one-axis class. All remaining hard-gate-passing cases map to GLOBAL_EXPECTATION_WITHOUT_BROAD_SUPPORT. The already seen global floor, train-validation symmetry, and zero-overlap grouped-split controls cannot rescue breadth.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_broad: On this fixed outcome-blind MLE-agent observed forest, treating root-to-leaf paths as independent 80/10/10 records would place exact shared-prefix canonical edges across train and test in expectation, and the newly frozen anonymous profile shows that the expected contaminated test-occurrence mass is broad across tasks and physical runs rather than dominated by one group. Fragment- or physical-run-grouped splitting prevents exact canonical-edge crossing by construction.

failure_rule: Any snapshot, hash, upstream aggregate, schema, graph, exact combinatoric identity, support, anonymity, byte-reproducibility, independent-verification, trace, or security mismatch fails closed. No split size, group axis, threshold, denominator, population, or classification order may change after task/run/fragment profile values are computed.
